question: Regarding the administration of drugs subcutaneously, which of the following statements is correct ?:

options.opa: The incorporation of vasoconstrictors, such as adrenaline, increases the speed of absorption.
options.opb: It is a parenteral route of difficult access.
options.opc: When drugs are administered in this way repeatedly, for example insulin in type I diabetics, it is recommended not to alternate the injection site to avoid the appearance of lipodystrophies.
options.opd: Solid forms of sustained release can be implanted to obtain extended periods of release of some drugs.

analysis: Subcutaneous administration of drugs is a common route used for various medications. It involves injecting the drug into the fatty tissue layer beneath the skin. Understanding the correct practices and considerations is crucial for optimal drug delivery and patient safety.
